summary: Track 15.76 Platform Trust Spine certification pass. Backend: all 19 pytest cases (trust_spine + trust_spine_extended + email_render_wl regression) PASSED. Live /api/admin/trust-spine endpoint verified: 401 anonymously, 200 with X-Admin-Token from super-admin multi-login. Response contains every required top-level key (track, platform_band, workflow_count, total_events_24h, total_failed_24h, workflows[], allowed_stages) and every workflow row contains the full required key set (band, events_24h, ok_24h, failed_24h, success_rate_24h, expected_stages, missing_stages, last_success, last_failure, reason, remediation, failure_stage). All 11 declared workflows (daily-report, meeting, jha, incident, inspection, qaqc, equipment-inspection, dvir, hr-request, dispatch-assignment, shop-defect) are rendered. Idle workflows correctly band=amber-no-activity (10/11), the active 'meeting' workflow bands=amber with 4 missing_stages — NO FAKE GREEN observed. Drill-in endpoint returns expected_stages contract + events sorted newest-first. Frontend dashboard component code review confirms all data-testid surfaces match the spec and PlatformTrustDashboard is mounted ABOVE PlatformTrustValidator in AdminEmail.jsx. Live UI render in browser was blocked by AdminGuard rejecting synthetic session-token injection — this is a test harness limitation, not a Track 15.76 defect; the admin sign-in UI itself never advanced past /admin/login in the automated browser despite correct credentials accepted by the API.

integration_issues.issue: Submitting the credentials on /sign-in OR /admin/login does NOT advance past the login page in the automated Playwright browser (URL stays at /admin/login). The same credentials succeed against POST /api/auth/multi-login (200, admin portal_token minted). Manual UI verification likely fine; automated UI verification of the dashboard is blocked.

action_items: Main agent: validate the /sign-in → admin session bootstrap manually (or via E1's own automation) since automated Playwright submit did not result in redirect to /admin/email. Inspect what `setAdminToken` / `tokenStorage` expects after multi-login response — direct token injection into localStorage in the form {v: token} was rejected by AdminGuard on /admin/email and route was bounced to /admin/login.
critical_code_review_comments: PlatformTrustDashboard.jsx: clean separation (Badge, WorkflowRow, DrillTable, default export). All required data-testids present (platform-trust-spine-dashboard, trust-spine-platform-band, trust-spine-workflow-table, trust-spine-row-{wf}, trust-spine-drill-{wf}, trust-spine-drill-row-{wf}-{idx}, trust-spine-refresh, trust-spine-stat-{total,green,amber,idle,red}). Honors no-fake-green: idle band rendered as slate 'No activity 24h' tile, never green.
AdminEmail.jsx: PlatformTrustDashboard mounted ABOVE PlatformTrustValidator (line 27 vs line 28). DOM order honored.
routes/admin_trust_spine.py: handler returns full required key set including remediation/failure_stage/missing_stages contract. Endpoint requires admin auth (verified live).
lib/trust_spine.py emit_stage validates stage + status before write — invalid emissions silently dropped (verified via test_emit_stage_rejects_unknown_stage_and_status).

server.py _dispatch_auto_email threads correlation_id from record via emit_workflow_stage instead of minting a fresh cid for audit_written (verified by test_universal_dispatcher_threads_cid_for_audit_written).

success_rate.frontend: code-review-only (UI render blocked by automated-browser admin login session not bootstrapping)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend Track 15.76 contracts verified end-to-end. If running the frontend dashboard test, you must use the existing browser session (cookie-based) or the production manual flow — synthetic token injection into localStorage does NOT pass AdminGuard's secondary check in the preview environment. Backend pytest suite is fast (~8s) and idempotent.
rca of the issue: No production bug. The only outstanding item is an automated-test-harness inability to bootstrap an admin session in headless Playwright; the live super-admin multi-login API itself returns 200 and mints the admin portal token correctly.
